research_question: Can two isolated source-only reviewers stably label route intrusion, boundary relation, alertability, passed-clear state and epistemic abstention under current-only or causal-history RGB?
claim_ceiling: consumed Development-only label mechanism and observability evidence
fixed-anchor observation agreement, not population label accuracy
no fresh, held-out, confirmation, training, model-effect, App, product or safety claim

predecessor_boundary.distinction: A0 labels route-envelope relation and current lifecycle evidence. It does not reuse VISIBLE_CENTRAL_OBSTRUCTION, STABLE_PRESENT, the one-second central-obstruction prompt, or central line-of-sight occupancy.

known_limitations.effect: This cohort cannot pass full onset readiness or authorize training even if fixed-anchor observation agreement passes.

observation_units.per_frame_materialization: For design inspection only, a fixed anchor label may be held over [anchor, next_anchor); every expanded row must retain source_anchor_id and interpolated=true. Agreement gates use only the 120 raw anchors, never expanded frames.

A0_P0_fixed_anchor_screen.purpose: Fail fast on an unstable or future-dependent ontology before spending review effort on every frame.
A0_P0_fixed_anchor_screen.pass_effect: Authorizes A0_P1 full-frame observation labeling only. It does not authorize a new cohort, training, model work or App changes.
A0_P0_fixed_anchor_screen.fail_effect: Close A0 with the applicable STOP terminal; do not manufacture 1,920-frame labels from an unreliable screen.

A0_P1_full_frame_annotation.required_if: A0_P0 reaches a current-only or causal-history observation pass
A0_P1_full_frame_annotation.scope: Produce primitive and derived labels for every one of the 1,920 frames under CURRENT_ONLY. For CAUSAL_HISTORY and HINDSIGHT_REFERENCE, label every frame with a complete frozen information window; frames without the required history/future context remain explicitly NOT_EVALUABLE and are never silently dropped or copied from an anchor.
A0_P1_full_frame_annotation.review: Two new isolated reviews per retained runtime condition; no P0 reviewer reuse, no cross-condition item exposure and no third-Agent adjudication.
A0_P1_full_frame_annotation.forbidden_shortcut: Anchor hold/interpolation is inspection-only and can never satisfy frame-by-frame labeling.
A0_P1_full_frame_annotation.pass_effect: May authorize design and collection of the new onset-complete session-disjoint matched-pair cohort. It still cannot authorize training.

A0_P2_new_cohort_contract.required_if: A0_P1 full-frame observation labels pass the frozen agreement gates
A0_P2_new_cohort_contract.scope: Freeze the session-disjoint, onset-complete matched-pair collection and evaluation contract before collecting or training.

CURRENT_ONLY.visible: RGB at t plus frozen image-space corridor grid and timestamp-relative current marker

CAUSAL_HISTORY.visible: RGB frames [t-10, ..., t] in timestamp order plus corridor grid on t

HINDSIGHT_REFERENCE.visible: RGB frames [t-10, ..., t+10] plus corridor grid on t

isolation.unresolved_policy: Retain disagreement and abstention. Never repair agreement by majority vote, third review, or UNKNOWN to negative conversion.

spatial_unit.claim: Coarse spatial-unit readiness only; not a pixel mask, physical collision envelope or final model target.

ontology.intruding_definition: Visible evidence in this cell occupies, crosses or cuts the apparent forward corridor at the current time. Object presence, semantic hazard type or corridor occupancy alone is insufficient.
ontology.non_intruding_definition: The cell is reviewable and visible evidence is lateral, parallel, already behind/cleared, or does not cut the apparent forward corridor. This is not a safety claim.
ontology.epistemic_unknown_rule: Agent UNKNOWN is abstention due to insufficient evidence. It is not the RISKSEG unknown_nonwalkable semantic class and never means NON_ACTIONABLE or SAFE.
ontology.pre_alert: Not a causal A0 target. It may be derived only inside HINDSIGHT_REFERENCE and may not supervise CURRENT_ONLY or CAUSAL_HISTORY.

derived_actionability.actionable_if: knownness == KNOWN AND alertable == YES AND passed == NO AND at least one intrusion cell == INTRUDING
derived_actionability.non_actionable_if: all required fields are evaluable and actionable_if is false

review_output.format: JSONL, one object per opaque review item

per_condition: boundary relation exact agreement on union-applicable anchors
intrusion-cell micro F1 with UNKNOWN excluded and disclosed
derived three-class confusion and exact agreement
first ACTIONABLE anchor delta when both routes contain ACTIONABLE

decision.new_cohort_design_authority: Only an A0_P1 full-frame observation pass may authorize a new matched-pair cohort contract. An A0_P0 fixed-anchor pass authorizes only A0_P1. The current cohort can never authorize model training because onset readiness is not evaluable.

required_strata: same obstacle before alertable versus after passed-clear
matched_pairs: same boundary semantics: transverse actionable versus parallel non-actionable
same obstacle identity: ahead alertable versus passed-clear while still visible
new_cohort_requirements_if_observation_p.onset_complete_requirement: Positive windows must include sufficient pre-alert frames and passed-clear frames; no left-truncated positive is eligible for onset confirmation.

model_design_boundary.future_total_loss_if_authorized: L = lambda_i*L_intrusion + lambda_b*L_boundary_relation + lambda_a*L_alertable + lambda_p*L_passed + lambda_k*L_knownness + lambda_s*L_semantic_aux, with every lambda >= 0
model_design_boundary.abstain_training_rule: Epistemic UNKNOWN is masked from actionability positives/negatives and handled by a separate knownness/abstention target.
model_design_boundary.hindsight_leakage_rule: HINDSIGHT_REFERENCE labels may not directly supervise a current-only or causal-history runtime head.

forbidden: PIDNet-M, SegFormer or other larger-model rescue
mask to bbox to RiskAnalyzer integration
pre_output_checks: all bound input hashes and 30/30/1920/8-8-7-7 cardinality match
all 120 anchors have complete t-10..t+10 source frames
CURRENT packets contain no past or future frame
CAUSAL packets contain no frame greater than t
HINDSIGHT packets and IDs are isolated from runtime passes
all six passes have distinct opaque item IDs and independently permuted order
no reviewer packet contains semantic paths, event/session identity, bucket, interval, oracle, truth or model output
tests, implementation hash lock and output new-directory checks pass
